beaches.name: Plakias (east end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the south-eastern end of Plakias Bay. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to July 2023 with nudity at 80-100% in that dune-screened section; a 2021 directory entry and Greek listicles (2021-2024) agree. A 2019 report relays a sunbed attendant's claim that the beach is officially nudist, with no authority named.

beaches.name: Ammoudaki (Mikro Ammoudi)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers share this organised cove between Damnoni and Ammoudi. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2020 putting nudity between 20% and 99% depending on season and crowd; a Crete beach guide and a 2024 Greek listicle call it a nudist beach. A 2021 directory entry calls it official but names no authority.

beaches.name: Agios Pavlos (Sandhills, western beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the beaches over the headland west of the main beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to July 2023, with the first cove mixed and the long western beach mostly nude; a second directory repeats the 2023 reports and a Rethymnon beach guide calls the dunes suitable for nudism. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Ligres
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised beyond the rocks east of the taverna and at Katsouni. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to August 2020; a Crete beach guide names Katsouni as the nudist cove and Greek listicles (2021-2024) list Ligres as nudist-friendly. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Triopetra (west of the rocks)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the long western stretch beyond the cantina and rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2004 to August 2020, typically 50-100% nude on weekdays; no report from the last three years was found. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Sarakiniko (Gavdos)
beaches.summary: The municipality banned nudism on Sarakiniko with signs in July 2023. The mayor told the press (1 July 2023) that the ban follows complaints and applies to no other beach; the signs were torn down and re-erected repeatedly that summer, and a June 2024 press piece quotes the municipality that the ban still stands. A naturist directory carries visitor reports of widespread nudity here from 2011 to 2020, all pre-dating the ban.

beaches.name: Agios Ioannis (Gavdos)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the whole beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2020 putting nudity at 70-100%; in July 2023 the mayor said the Sarakiniko ban applies to no other beach, and a June 2024 press report quotes the municipality that nudism is permitted on ten other beaches. No signage is documented.

beaches.name: Dytiko (Diskos), Lentas
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the beach, with nudity concentrated at the eastern end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2021; a 2017 Cretan news article calls it an established beach for nudists and a 2021 directory entry lists it as a nude beach. Older reports mention a painted request not to bathe nude in front of the buildings; no report is newer than 2021 and no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Trafoulas (Trachoulas), east of Lentas
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the cove at the mouth of the Trafoulas gorge. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2021; the 2021 report found a roughly 60/40 mix of clothed and nude, the 2020 report mainly nudists, and a German directory entry dated 17 September 2020 reports about 20 couples, all nude. No designation or signage is documented and no report is newer than 2021.

beaches.name: Hersonissos nudists' beach (η παραλία των γυμνιστών)
beaches.summary: Nude use is the norm on a cove the municipal beach guide names the nudists' beach. The Hersonissos municipality's beach page lists it after the Limanakia coves and a little east of the blue-flag beaches by the Agios Georgios church, with little sand and a rock flat; it states no rule, designation or signage.

beaches.name: Lagada (Langada / Eftyhia), Makrigialos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported along most of the beach, with the western end most used. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to 2023, one in 2016 describing a large informal 'Nude Friendly Beach' sign at the west end; a Cretan beach guide says part of the beach is preferred by nudists and a 2021 German directory entry lists it as a nudist beach. No authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Chrissi (Gaidouronisi) island
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported west of Golden Beach and in south-east coves. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to 2014 at Shell Beach and beyond the northern headland, one noting a local scolding a nude bather; a 2012 Cretan magazine entry answers 'nudism: yes'. A ministerial decision published 22 May 2026 limits visitors to delimited beaches and landings to designated piers; whether the reported spots remain reachable is not documented.

beaches.name: Diaskari, Makrigialos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the eastern end and in a small cove beyond the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to 2016 with mixed findings; the May 2016 report notes local acceptance of that end, the September 2016 report found only clothed bathers. No report is newer than 2016 and no designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Sougia (east end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern part of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to September 2023; a 2021 directory entry, a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2017-2024) name the same eastern section. A 2001 report mentions an old no-nudism sign that was ignored, and a 2018 note reports a village vote against beach camping; no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Kedrodasos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the whole beach, more nude at the eastern end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2018 ranging from 20% to 100% nude; a 2021 directory entry says about half; a Crete beach guide and a 2024 Greek listicle call it a naturist favourite. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Paleochora, Pachia Ammos (north end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the northern end of the long western town beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to October 2023 and describes signs near the taverna separating the nude and clothed sections; a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2017-2024) name the same end. Who placed the signs is not documented.

beaches.name: Gialiskari (Anidri beaches)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern half of the easternmost Anidri beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to September 2023, placing the nude section beyond the first block of sunbeds; a 2016 note claims a tourist-office brochure mentions it, which is unverified. No signage is documented.

beaches.name: Falassarna (north end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the northern end of the main beach, among the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2018 that conflict: some find the area fully clothed, others up to 20% nude; a 2010-11 report mentions a nudist-beach sign later removed, and a 2021 directory entry claims a sign. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Kommos (Potamos section)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the central stretch north of the archaeological site. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to 2022 placing the nude section between the site and the Kalamaki rocks, with both ends clothed; a 2017 Cretan news article says the northern part, called Potamos, is used almost exclusively by nudists, and a 2026 listicle repeats this. No designation or signage is documented; the beach is a Caretta caretta nesting site.

beaches.name: Kokkini Ammos (Red Beach), Matala
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the whole beach; no fixed nude section. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1996 to 2023 describing informal 'Nude beach - FKK' signs on the path and a beach bar with sunbeds; the nude share varies by season and time of day. Greek press in July 2026 reported its inclusion in a CNN list of nude beaches; no authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agiofarago
beaches.summary: Nude bathing was reported here in the past; recent reports find none. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 (60% nude) to 2023 (no nudists), and a 2018 report describes a notice at the gorge entrance that the place is holy and visitors should not go nude. A 2021 German directory entry says nudity is unproblematic off season, a local accommodation site says nudism is prohibited out of respect for the monks, and no authority decree is documented.

beaches.name: Filaki (Φυλακή) — Vritomartis naturist beach
beaches.summary: The whole beach is naturist; the operator calls it a compulsory naturist area. Vritomartis, which describes itself as a licensed naturist resort, runs the beach 700 m from the hotel and states that the other beaches it lists nearby are not official naturist beaches. Law 1399/1983 makes nudity lawful on the beach in front of a licensed naturist centre; the licence itself is not published online.

beaches.name: Orthi Ammos (Frangokastello)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the eastern end of the beach, below the dunes. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to September 2023; a 2020 report and a 2021 directory entry describe a sign marking the nude section, which a 2023 report says has gone. A Crete beach guide says nudist numbers are falling; who placed the sign is not documented.

beaches.name: Glyka Nera (Sweetwater Beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern part of the beach, away from the taverna. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to September 2023; a 2014 report notes a dress-properly sign at the taverna sunbeds, and a 2025 review on a nude-beach map estimates 60% nude further from the boat landing. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agia Roumeli (east of the river)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised east of the Samaria river mouth, on the rocky shore. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to 2021; a 2021 directory entry, a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2021-2024) also name the ends of the beach. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Psili Ammos, south of Vai
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on the cove over the headland south of Vai. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2023 describing informal multilingual 'Nudist beach' signs on the path and a nude share that varies from a minority in August to a majority in September; a 2021 German directory entry and a Cretan beach guide also list it as nudist. Vai beach itself is not used for nude bathing; no authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Itanos (Erimoupoli), southern cove
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in the southern cove at Itanos. The northern beaches are mostly clothed; a naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to 2023, the latest describing an informal naturist sign at the entrance, and a 2021 German directory entry describes stones painted as FKK markers. A Cretan beach guide lists it as nudist-friendly; no authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Alona (Krinakia / Katsounaki), Xerokampos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on the northernmost Xerokampos beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2012 to 2023; the August 2023 report found about ten nudists at the left end, facing the sea, among some fifty clothed bathers, while September reports from 2019 and 2020 found a nude majority. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Argilos and Gerontolakkos, Xerokampos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the clay-backed Argilos beach south of Xerokampos. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2018 to 2023 covering Argilos and the small Gerontolakkos cove; June 2018 and September 2019 found mostly nude bathers, while August 2023 found no nudity in high season. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Kouremenos bay north of Chiona, Palekastro
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on Palekastro bay just north of the Chiona hill. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to 2018, the later ones noting few nudists and a cruising atmosphere; a 2026 listicle says the less accessible ends see informal naturist use. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Botzalaki, Goudouras
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the far end of the beach below the car park before Goudouras. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2010 and 2021; the 2021 report notes angry reactions from Greek families on a Sunday. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Tertsa, western beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the beach west of the village, beyond the rocks. The beach nearest the village is clothed; a naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2016, the last describing a hand-painted 'nudists' sign on the rocks, and a 2012 Cretan magazine entry answers 'nudism: yes'. No report is newer than 2016 and no authority designation is documented.
